All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
AutoChooser
A dashboard auto picker, modeled on Choreo's choreo.auto.AutoChooser.
AutoFactory
Entry point for robot code, modeled on Choreo's choreo.auto.AutoFactory.
AutoRoutine
A trigger-based auto, modeled on Choreo's choreo.auto.AutoRoutine.
AutoTrajectory
A trajectory (or one split segment) in an AutoRoutine, modeled on Choreo's choreo.auto.AutoTrajectory: a follow command plus triggers for its timeline.
BeachDetector
Decides when the robot is beached (sitting tilted on fuel) from IMU pitch and roll, and which way is downhill.
Bridge
A short recovery path from the robot's current state onto the trajectory.
Bridge.Segment
One piece of a bridge.
BridgePlanner
Plans a fast "bridge" from the robot's current state back onto the trajectory.
BridgePlanner.Result
Planner result with diagnostics.

BumpInjector
Simulated collisions for testing recovery at a desk.
CollisionDetector
Decides when the robot has been knocked off its path: either a horizontal accelerometer spike, or tracking error that stays above the bridge thresholds for several loops.
ConvexPolygon
A convex polygon with separating-axis-theorem collision tests.
CtreSwerve
CTRE Phoenix 6 swerve integration.
DriveCommand
What the drivetrain should do this loop: field-relative (blue origin) chassis speeds plus optional per-module field-frame force feedforwards in newtons (module order FL, FR, BL, BR).
FieldSymmetry
How the field is symmetric between alliances.
FollowerConfig
Gains and limits for trajectory following.
FuelPileInjector
A simulated pile of fuel for testing auto unbeach at a desk.
HolonomicFollower
Feedforward + saturated proportional feedback.
IntakeSpan
A stretch of the trajectory where the intake is planned to be extended (an "Intake extended" constraint in the app).
MayhemTelemetry
Publishes runner state to NetworkTables (also captured in DataLog if NT logging is on).
MayhemTrajectory
A solved Mayhem trajectory (or one split segment of it).
Quintic
1-D quintic polynomial with position/velocity/acceleration boundary conditions.
RecoveryConfig
Tuning for bump detection and recovery.
RecoveryData
Geometry and limits exported by the app for on-robot bump recovery.
SleipnirBridgeRefiner
Optional background refinement of a recovery bridge using Sleipnir (the optimizer behind Choreo).

TrajectoryEvent
A named event marker.

What to do with this event if bump recovery skips over its time.
TrajectoryLoader
Loads .mtraj files written by the Mayhem app.
TrajectoryRunner
Runs one trajectory: feedforward + saturated feedback, time dilation, bump detection and bridge recovery, auto unbeach, rough-terrain handling, and event markers.
